🧭 Local travel essentials
Getting around
Seoul metro (lines 1 & 2, Incheon Airport Railway) & connections + buses. T-money & Cashbee work.
See more
Late-night transit
Metro & airport rail close around midnight (Seoul-bound transfers may close earlier). After Munhak Stadium, taxis or Kakao T are your options. Heading back to Seoul? Check your connection window ahead.
Payment
Cards & mobile payments widely accepted.
Currency & exchange
Korean Won (KRW, ₩)—card is standard.
Language
Korean. English is better near the airport.
Local apps
Kakao T (Taxi & ride apps) · Naver Map (Public transit routes) · Kakao Pay (QR codes, quick-pay)
Late-night transit
Kakao T (Night-taxi standard (90%+ market share, fastest matching). Foreign phone sign-up restricted.) · Uber (Taxi hailing—bring your overseas card & number. Made for travelers.) · TADA (Carnival vans—sign up with your overseas number & card.) · i.M (Book premium minivan taxis.) · K-RIDE (Traveler-only taxis (no KakaoTalk; Seoul, Incheon & metro).)  📶 eSIM ↗
How to book
Skip Munhak Stadium's main gate. Returning to Seoul? Nail your last-train time first—miss it? Grab a taxi.
Around the venue
Olive Young Inspire Branch 📍Olive Young inside the resort mall. Walk over for K-beauty shopping before and after the concert.
Inspire Aurora (Media Art) 📍World's largest-scale LED dome media art. Free media shows—the signature photo spot.
